name: Actinic keratosis (field therapy)
advice: Expect redness, crusting and soreness during treatment — this shows it is working; stop and return if very painful. Daily sunscreen and hat. Any thick, tender, bleeding or fast-growing spot needs biopsy (skin cancer).
